question: trim-adds
answer:
The **Fjord Plus** includes everything in the Pure, plus these standard features: (voltrieve-fjord-price-list.pdf)

- Power tailgate with hands-free opening
- Keyless entry
- 360-degree camera

For a complete **left-front brake replacement** on your Fjord AWD, the service guide calls for the following. The AWD uses a 370 mm front disc.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front brake pad set, both sides | **VP-10254**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) |
| 1 | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1-litre bottle | **VP-15168**  (voltrieve-parts-service-items.md) |

The pad set covers **both front wheels**; the guide says pads are renewed as an axle set even when working on one side. The fluid is for bleeding the circuit afterwards.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

Before work under the car, the guide says to put it in service mode. Before lifting the Fjord, turn off automatic levelling from the centre screen.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a complete **front-left brake replacement** on your Fjord AWD, the service guide calls for the following. The article numbers are from the spare-parts catalog. (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | VP-10072 |
| 1 | Front brake pad set, for both sides | VP-10254 |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | VP-10345 |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | VP-10527 |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | VP-10631 |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | VP-10670 |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | VP-10709 |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | VP-10761 |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, for bleeding | VP-15168 |

The pads are replaced as an **axle set**, even though the rest of the job is on the left side. The kit contains four pads for both front sides. (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a complete front-left brake replacement, buy **one of each item below**. Choose the drive-specific parts for your Lumen, then add the parts common to both drives. (voltrieve-service-guide.md)  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

### Choose for your drive

| Part | RWD | AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | VP-10020, 300 mm | VP-10033, 320 mm |
| Front brake pad set | VP-10202 | VP-10215 |
| Front-left brake caliper | VP-10293 | VP-10306 |
| Front-left caliper carrier | VP-10475 | VP-10488 |

(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

### For either drive

- Front-left brake hose: **VP-10618**
- Front caliper fitting kit: **VP-10696**
- Front-left brake dust shield: **VP-10735**
- DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1-litre bottle: **VP-15168**

(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

The pad set covers **both front wheels**, and the guide says to renew pads as an axle set. The right-side disc and caliper stay in place unless they are worn too. The Lumen has no electrical pad-wear sensor. Check whether yours is RWD or AWD before ordering. (voltrieve-service-guide.md)  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)
